sentences.text: Hey everyone, today I want to talk about the one habit that changed how I work.
It is not an app, and it is not a fancy notebook.
Every morning, I write the day's plan on a single index card.
The card has room for a handful of things, and that limit is the point.
The card has room for a handful of things, and that limit is the point.
I started this in 2019 with three people in a shared office.
When the card is full, the important decisions are already finished.
I now finish forty percent more of what I plan, the best stretch of my working life.
Some days I still fall behind, and the card just waits for tomorrow.
So why does something this small work?
Because it forces a choice before the day makes it for you.
Try it for a week and tell me what happens.
That is all for today, and thanks for watching.
